pages.text: Armor is the main defence. Take any armor to a $(item)Sewing Table$() and sew insulation onto it. Insulators such as Goat Fur and Hoglin Hide have their own item tab. JEI has a Sewing Recipes category.
pages.title: Armor
Sewing Table
pages.text: Crafted from wool and planks. Adds insulation from items like Goat Fur to armor, held as cold or heat resistance.
Goat Fur and Hoglin Hide come from goats and hoglins. Finished sets exist: Goat Fur, Hoglin and Chameleon Scale armor. Hover any piece to read its insulation.
pages.title: Fur and hide
Goat Fur Parka
pages.text: One of the ready-made sets. Its insulation is shown in the tooltip. Cold Sweat's Chameleon, a tameable lizard, sheds scales for another set.

A $(item)Hearth$() keeps the area around it comfortable. It takes fuel (see the Hearth Fuel category in JEI).$(br2)A $(item)Boiler$() warms and an $(item)Icebox$() cools. Put a Smokestack on top to make an area livable.
pages.title: Blocks
Hearth
pages.text: Fuel it, put it in the base. Its range and the fuels it takes are in JEI. Boiler and Icebox have their own fuel lists.

pages.title: Waterskin
pages.text: Cold Sweat's own drink container. Its tooltip shows the keys to drink and pour. A Create Spout can fill it. It carries Thirst purity: purify it in a furnace or campfire.
A full Create netherite diving set (netherite backtank, diving helmet, netherite leggings, diving boots) adds heat dampening and shrugs off the wet effect. The backtank tooltip shows the hint.
